what_i_found: Your moving lantern reveals otherwise invulnerable ghosts and strengthens your defenses, but it also accelerates the enemies inside its beam. You must keep repositioning the light while your towers hold a haunted toy theatre until dawn. Nested dolls split into faster toys, while sleep, wake-up shockwaves, and ghostlight pools let six build sites support different strategies.
